_about: The Sea of Storms and Port Halyon (levels 3-34): the port's watch walks Main Street and answers its citizens; smugglers in the tar tunnels help each other; the Cult of Terror's cultists, effigies and shades answer their own; the great sea serpents, the hooded cultists, the shades of Carcosa and the executioner are elites; the Pallid Herald waits in Lost Carcosa; and the High Priest of Terror holds the Grand Temple, darkening it as he weakens and calling his faithful.

120500.name: pallid herald
120500.long_desc: The Pallid Herald stands in the dim street, its pale mask turned toward you.
120500.description: A tall figure in tattered yellow robes, its face hidden behind a smooth mask the colour of old bone. It brings word from a city that should not exist, and no one who hears that word sleeps well again.

120501.name: high priest terror
120501.long_desc: The High Priest of Terror stands before the great altar, arms raised to something unseen.
120501.description: Gaunt, shaven and painted with symbols that hurt to look at, in robes black as tar. He has given his eyes to his god, and two pits of shadow see you all the same.

phases.message: The High Priest of Terror tears his robe open: "Behold my god, and DESPAIR!"
